svg.title: AgentBuff: data model
svg.desc: user: Account with role, suspension and deletion state, and a session epoch used to revoke every session at once. user_container: One per user: loopback port, bridge token, status, resource limits, health and usage stats. user_agent: Each AI employee's definition with its factory persona and live persona, linked to the ready-made package it came from. api_key: AI keys entered during onboarding, encrypted with AES-256-GCM and then applied to the user's container. subscription / user_trial / trial_grant: One active plan per user, the 14-day trial, and a trial ledger keyed by hashed email that survives account deletion. transaction: Payment ledger for plans, marketplace purchases and support payments, with a unique Midtrans order id. skill_catalog / skill_entitlement: Marketplace products and what each user owns, with expiry for monthly products. paket_agen_versi / agen_rekrutan: Versioned ready-made AI employee packages and each hire with its interview answers and install steps. prompt_policy: Platform, account and agent level rules that are layered into every agent. antrean_agen: Queue for creating and waking agent containers when the server is busy. oauth_client / oauth_grant / oauth_token: Authorization server for the admin MCP server: registered clients, connections and rotating tokens. masuk_aplikasi / masuk_grant: Partner apps registered for Sign in with AgentBuff and the user's consent per app.
